getting-started.name: Getting started tour
getting-started.description: A quick guided tour of the core dashboard areas.

steps.title: Welcome to Northstar
steps.body: This quick tour shows the key areas of the dashboard and where to find help at any time.

steps.title: Track your KPIs
steps.body: These cards summarize what matters most. They’re a common place to attach contextual guidance when users are learning.

steps.title: Filters & saved views
steps.body: Power users can save filter presets. Walkthrough steps can be anchored to controls like this and explain impact before a user changes anything.

steps.title: Contextual help is one click away
steps.body: Look for the (?) icon across the UI. It opens contextual help with ‘Show me how’ to start a guided walkthrough.

saved-views.name: Saved views walkthrough
saved-views.description: Show how to create and reuse a saved view.

steps.title: Start with filters
steps.body: Choose filters to narrow your dataset. We’ll save this as a reusable view.

steps.title: Save the current view
steps.body: Click here to save your current filters as a named view. In a real app, this might open a modal.

steps.title: Switch between views
steps.body: Saved views can be shared with teammates and used to standardize reporting.

missing-target-demo.name: Missing target demo
missing-target-demo.description: Demonstrates graceful handling when a selector is not found.

steps.title: Graceful fallback when targets change
steps.body: If the UI changes or a feature is gated, the DAP shouldn’t break. This step intentionally points to a missing element.

filters-help.title: Filters
filters-help.summary: Filters narrow your results and can be saved as reusable views.
readMore: Use filters to focus on a segment (e.g., enterprise customers, a region, or a time range).
Saved views help teams standardize reporting and reduce repetitive setup.

kpis-help.title: KPI cards
kpis-help.summary: These KPIs update in real time as filters change.
readMore: KPI cards are great for quick health checks and daily monitoring.
In production, a DAP might include guidance on interpreting metrics and recommended actions.
